content: {"praised":["Bugs Bunny cartoons are slick and funny.","Mid to late 40s/50s Bugs Bunny found his groove.","Collection includes many favorite shorts.","Variety of classic Looney Tunes characters showcased.","Humor remains timeless and entertaining."],"criticized":["Cropped picture makes cartoons look lousy.","Widescreen presentation is disingenuous and poor.","Some cartoons are lackluster or downright terrible.","Missing Foghorn Leghorn and other classic characters.","Cropping issue prevents full theatrical view."]}
